steps.twoLines: Now each hand has its own melody, in its own rhythm: while one holds a long note, the other moves. If you need to, practice each hand alone first, then together, slowly, listening to both lines.
steps.longAndShort: The right hand holds, the left hand moves.
steps.shortAndLong: Now the other way round: the right hand moves, the left hand holds.
steps.minuetAsWritten: The “Minuet in G” from Unit 7, now with the left hand Petzold wrote: a line of its own, with a chord to begin and running eighth notes, and the first part’s repeat.
